findings.message: The CRD dnsendpoints.externaldns.k8s.io under crds/ changed (spec.endpoints.items required, spec.endpoints.items.providerSpecific.items required, spec.endpoints.items.recordType enum). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.

The CRD dnsrecords.externaldns.k8s.io under crds/ changed (spec.endpoint required, spec.endpoint.providerSpecific.items required, spec.endpoint.recordType enum). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
